arguments.command:
python -c "
import argparse
parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(prog='test')
s = parser.add_subparsers(dest='command', required=True)
parser_bump = s.add_parser('bump', help='Bumps a version')
parser_bump.set_defaults(which='bump')
sb = parser_bump.add_subparsers(title='Bump commands', dest='bump_type', required=True)
for p in (sb.add_parser('major', help='Bump major'),
          sb.add_parser('minor', help='Bump minor')):
    p.add_argument('version', help='Version')

try:
    args = parser.parse_args(['bump'])
    print(f'args.command={args.command}, args.bump_type={args.bump_type}')
except SystemExit as e:
    print(f'SystemExit with code {e.code}')
" 2>&1
